summary: Electra Battery Materials Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the award of a C$25 million construction package for a solvent extraction building at its cobalt sulfate refinery. The contract was awarded to WB Melback Corporation. No special situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change—is described. The content concerns ordinary operational progress; therefore, this is not a special situation.
